concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-onboard-users-pci-forms]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms guide to sales-channel-dependent user SAQs, hosted/custom-UI signing and Legal Entity Management API document/status routes; submission is not independent PCI or capability approval.
warnings: PCI SAQ signing is the platform user's declaration; the guide does not independently prove current PCI DSS compliance, Adyen approval or granted card-processing/payout capability.
Keep main/user legal entity, individual signer legal entity and account holder distinct; sales channels govern questionnaire need, and an empty generated reference array means none is required.
The webhook JSON and API samples are test examples; `enabled`, `requested`, `allowed` and `verificationStatus` have distinct meanings and do not establish a real account holder's state.
